page.overview:
Who is Bragi?

Bragi is the Norse god of poetry and eloquence — part of Norse mythology.

He had runes carved on his tongue and gave humans the Mead of Poetry. Bragi was rather a minor character in Marvel comics, he only appeared on 2 issues.thumb|One of Bragi's appearances in Marvel comics.

In Norse mythology, Bragi sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
